t: This is Piscator, also known as the Euston Head, a large abstract sculpture in the forecourt of Euston Station. British Rail commissioned it from Eduardo Paolozzi in 1980. Paolozzi was a Scottish artist, widely considered a pioneer of pop art. The work is named for Erwin Piscator, a German theatre director. Along with Bertolt Brecht, he was the foremost exponent of epic theatre, which stresses the social and political content of drama over emotional manipulation of the audience.
